metadata.question: Was the water extent around the location (11.184384, 35.114837) greater on February 14, 2022 than on February 6, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Use JRC Yearly Water Classification History v1.3 (`JRC/GSW1_3/YearlyHistory`) - Location: Point at longitude 11.184384, latitude 35.114837 - Dates: 2019-02-06 and 2022-02-14 (use the corresponding yearly layers: 2019 and 2022) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed, water classification layers are static annual composites - Use the "waterClass" band: values 0 (no data), 1 (not water), 2 (seasonal water), 3 (permanent water) 3. Logic for answer: - Compare total water pixel counts (seasonal + permanent) within a small buffer around the point for both dates. - If either collection fails or results are None/NaN → C3 - If any of the yearly images has zero valid pixels → C2 - If 2022 count > 2019 count → A (Yes), else → B (No) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') loc = ee.Geometry.Point([11.184384, 35.114837]).buffer(1000) # Fetch the yearly water history col_2019 = ee.ImageCollection("JRC/GSW1_3/YearlyHistory").filter(ee.Filter.eq('year', 2019)) col_2022 = ee.ImageCollection("JRC/GSW1_3/YearlyHistory").filter(ee.Filter.eq('year', 2022)) if col_2019.size().getInfo() == 0 or col_2022.size().getInfo() == 0: print("Missing water layers for one date.") print("C1") quit() # Extract water class (2 = seasonal, 3 = permanent) img19 = col_2019.first().select('waterClass') img22 = col_2022.first().select('waterClass') # Count water pixels (value >=2) within buffer sum19 = img19.gte(2).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=loc, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['waterClass'] sum22 = img22.gte(2).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=loc, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['waterClass'] if sum19 is None or sum22 is None: print("C3") elif sum19 + sum22 == 0 and sum19 == 0: print("Zero water pixels both dates.") print("C2") else: print(f"Water pixels 2019: {int(sum19)}, 2022: {int(sum22)}") print("A" if sum22 > sum19 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

loc = ee.Geometry.Point([11.184384, 35.114837]).buffer(1000)

# Fetch the yearly water history
col_2019 = ee.ImageCollection("JRC/GSW1_3/YearlyHistory").filter(ee.Filter.eq('year', 2019))
col_2022 = ee.ImageCollection("JRC/GSW1_3/YearlyHistory").filter(ee.Filter.eq('year', 2022))

if col_2019.size().getInfo() == 0 or col_2022.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("Missing water layers for one date.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    quit()

# Extract water class (2 = seasonal, 3 = permanent)
img19 = col_2019.first().select('waterClass')
img22 = col_2022.first().select('waterClass')

# Count water pixels (value >=2) within buffer
sum19 = img19.gte(2).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=loc, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['waterClass']
sum22 = img22.gte(2).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=loc, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['waterClass']

if sum19 is None or sum22 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif sum19 + sum22 == 0 and sum19 == 0:
    print("Zero water pixels both dates.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Water pixels 2019: {int(sum19)}, 2022: {int(sum22)}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if sum22 > sum19 else "<answer>B</answer>")
